subject: Request: short-term pilot credits while PO processes
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily@cedarpointlabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement is stuck, can we avoid churn?

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note — our procurement team has put a temporary hold on vendor onboarding while they reconcile a budget adjustment. The engineering team is mid-evaluation and the sandbox hits are important to decide. Our PO is in review but unlikely to clear this week.

Is there any way Redwood can keep our pilot active for another week (or provide a short credit) so we don't lose momentum? We can't commit to payment until the PO moves, but we want to continue testing the Redwood APIs against real data (sanitized).

If helpful I can share the PO reference (PO-CP-9923) and an expected approval ETA of Aug 31. Appreciate any flexibility.

—Emily
Emily Carter
Director of ML Platform
CedarPoint Labs
emily@cedarpointlabs.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot access — procurement is stuck, can we avoid churn?

Ben / Priyom — forwarding CedarPoint's note. Engineering has been actively prototyping with our embeddings + reranking flow; they told Emily the pilot is critical for their internal decision. PO is "in review" (PO-CP-9923), expected end of month, but could slip.

Proposed short-term option to avoid losing the deal: offer a 7-day pilot runway preservation credit covering up to 1M tokens (~$750 of usage) with these conditions:
- Credit active immediately upon our confirmation email to CedarPoint.
- PO must be submitted/acknowledged by purchasing (purchasing@cedarpointlabs.com) within 10 calendar days from activation.
- If PO is not received in 10 days, access will revert and any additional usage will be billed at standard rates.

Operational asks: finance needs a promo code or transient account flag so charges don't start while PO is clearing. Legal — simple one-page confirmation (I attached a draft SOW/credit agreement for sign-off).

If you approve I will send the activation note to Emily and attach the agreement. Ben — can Finance create the promo and flag CedarPoint as "PO pending"? Rishi — looping you for a quick sign-off on the wording in the attached agreement.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot access — procurement is stuck, can we avoid churn?

Vanessa — good plan. Approve the 7-day, up-to-1M-token credit as a one-time accommodation for CedarPoint. Please make the activation contingent on the PO reference and capture the expected PO date in the email.

Rishi — can Finance create a temporary promo code and set the account to "PO-pending" so billing doesn't accrue before PO is received? If legal needs to tweak the one-page agreement, escalate to Legal Ops, but this should be straightforward.

Priyom — once we confirm activation, can you and I remain available for any procurement questions? Might be worth offering a 15-minute call with purchasing to speed sign-off.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Activation: 7-day pilot runway credit for CedarPoint Labs (PO-CP-9923)

Hi Emily — thanks for the quick update earlier.

We can activate a one-time 7-day pilot runway preservation credit for CedarPoint Labs covering up to 1,000,000 tokens (internal estimate ~$750) starting now. Details:
- Activation window: 2027-08-30 to 2027-09-06 inclusive.
- Credit cap: 1,000,000 tokens. Any usage beyond that during the window will be billed at standard rates unless a PO is received and applied retroactively.
- Condition: Please provide the PO reference (PO-CP-9923) or a scanned confirmation to purchasing@cedarpointlabs.com within 10 calendar days (by 2027-09-09). If we do not receive a PO by then, access will revert to trial-limited mode and billed usage will be reconciled per our standard terms.

Attached: CedarPoint_trial_credit_agreement.pdf (one-page confirmation) and the draft SOW we referenced earlier (CedarPoint_SOW_v1.pdf). HubSpot case link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/53421/company/cedarpoint-labs (HS-53421).

If you want, Ben and Priyom are available for a brief alignment call with procurement to accelerate PO processing — just propose a time.

Looking forward to continuing the evaluation.

Best,
